title: Closing thoughts on Bunk's band and George Lewis
summary: He prefers jazz to better money, praises George Lewis's band as authentic, and wishes to reunite it.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: You know. Well we're getting near the end of this. Is there anything else you'd like to add on here? Well. Well. Well. I.

I just like to add that I like the jazz. When I went to New York with Bunk's band, Bill, I could have made more money playing with Smiling Joe. But I like the jazz so much that I'd rather be with them. And right now, Bill, I think that George Lewis who has the band, has one of the greatest authentic jazz bands that ever live in. And that there will never be another band like his after those minutes have passed. Well they got on record a lot of times. A lot of people have heard you all over the world.
Yeah. So that last part of his career, so the last few years is well recorded there too. Yeah, I made a lot of recording with them and I sure miss them, Bill.
And I wish that someday that I could get that band back together. Yeah. And I really would like to get them back.
